verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

verses.he: רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שבות [שְׁבִ֣ית] יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: LORD, Thou hast been favourable unto Thy land, Thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob.

verses.he: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲו‍ֹ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. Selah .
Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath; Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thine anger.

verses.he: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Thine indignation toward us to cease.

verses.he: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.en: Wilt Thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt Thou draw out Thine anger to all generations?
Wilt Thou not quicken us again, That Thy people may rejoice in Thee?
Show us Thy mercy, O LORD, And grant us Thy salvation.

verses.he: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל׀ יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃
verses.en: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; For He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.

verses.he: אַ֤ךְ׀ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.en: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him; That glory may dwell in our land.
Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.he: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃
verses.en: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

verses.he: גַּם־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Yea, the LORD will give that which is good; And our land shall yield her produce.

verses.he: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.en: Righteousness shall go before Him, And shall make His footsteps a way.
